module: Node "Toggle Coupling" (category `repeat_p_duration`, tags attach/detach/trailer/couple). Controls a vehicle's couplers according to the `data.mode` property: `toggle` (`beamstate.toggleCouplers()`), `activate` (`activateAutoCoupling()`, default), `disable` (`disableAutoCoupling()`), `detach` (`detachCouplers()`). Input pin: `vehId`. If `vehId` is not connected, the node takes the player vehicle (`getPlayerVehicle(0)`).
notes: The mode is not a pin: it is `self.data.mode`, set in the editor. An unknown value displays "(!)" in the node and does nothing.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

drawMiddle.desc: ImGui display in the center of the node in the flowgraph editor; purely visual.

work.desc: Sends the beamstate command matching `data.mode` to the vehicle.
